summary: State-licensed security guard with 9 years of continuous experience patrolling commercial and industrial premises for a well-established local employer. Skilled in access control, alarm response, incident reporting, and de-escalation of rule violations.

experience.title: Security Guard (State Guard Card)
bullets: Monitor and authorize entrance and departure of employees, visitors, and contractors at a multi-building commercial campus, checking credentials at two gates and logging approximately 300 entries per shift.

Patrol industrial and commercial premises on foot and by vehicle to detect signs of intrusion and confirm that doors, windows, and gates are secure; document and resolve an average of 12 security or maintenance irregularities per week.
Answer alarms and investigate disturbances, coordinating with local emergency services and clearing 100% of false-alarm calls within 15 minutes.
Lock and unlock entrances and exits on a fixed schedule, maintaining a zero-incident record for unauthorized after-hours access over the past year.
Write daily activity and incident reports covering property damage, theft, unauthorized persons, and unusual occurrences, producing 40+ reports per month with no errors found in supervisor audits.
Warn persons of rule infractions and evict violators from premises when necessary, defusing roughly 20 disputes per quarter without escalation to force.
Respond to medical emergencies by administering basic first aid and obtaining assistance from paramedics, completing annual CPR and first aid recertification.

experience.title: Security Officer
bullets: Circulated among visitors, patrons, and employees in a retail and office complex to preserve order and protect property, supporting a site with up to 1,500 daily visitors.
Monitored and authorized entrance and departure of employees and visitors, issuing and tracking temporary badges and reducing tailgating incidents by 30% through stricter checkpoint procedures.
Investigated alarm activations and disturbances across a 6-acre property, documenting findings and notifying management within the same shift.
Patrolled parking areas and perimeter fencing, identifying and reporting 50+ security deficiencies that were subsequently repaired.
Maintained daily activity logs and irregularity reports, including equipment damage and suspected theft, in a digital reporting system.
Trained 4 newly hired guards on post orders, patrol routes, and report writing.

experience.title: Security Guard
bullets: Secured a warehouse and distribution yard by locking and unlocking gates and entrances at scheduled times and verifying seals on outbound trailers.
Patrolled the premises on rotating shifts to prevent and detect intrusion, checking doors, windows, gates, and perimeter lighting on every round.
Warned persons of rule infractions such as smoking in prohibited areas and unauthorized parking, and escorted violators off the premises when required.
Responded to medical emergencies by providing basic first aid and summoning paramedics for two workplace injuries.
Wrote reports of daily activities and irregularities, including equipment damage and unusual occurrences, for review by the site supervisor.

experience.title: Security Guard
experience.employer: a local event and venue services contractor
bullets: Monitored and authorized entrance and departure of patrons and staff at venues hosting up to 800 attendees, checking tickets and bags at entry points.
Circulated among visitors and employees to preserve order and protect property during events and overnight setup periods.
Answered alarms and investigated disturbances, coordinating with venue management and local police when necessary.
Wrote shift reports covering unauthorized persons, theft, and unusual occurrences, submitting them at the close of every shift.
Completed state guard card training and maintained the license in good standing throughout employment.
